mapper.select:
select D.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, D.BOOKSET_NAME as booksetName, A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, C.FEE_TYPE as feeType,
A.PRIN as prin, DATE_FORMAT(A.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as vdate, DATE_FORMAT(A.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') as mdate from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT A inner join BOK_DETAIL_ID B on B.BUSI_ID = A.FINPROD_ID and B.TRADE_ID = A.FINPROD_ID inner join TRD_TRADE_FEE_DETAIL C on C.TRADE_ID = A.FINPROD_ID
and C.IS_PREPAID = 'Y' inner join BOK_BOOKSET D on D.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID where A.FINPROD_TYPE = 'C19'
AND D.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
and C.FEE_TYPE in
#{item}
and A.VDATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{vdate},'%Y-%m-%d')
and A.MDATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{mdate},'%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY B.BOOKSET_ID,A.VDATE DESC
